title: Rojak Rush turns Malaysian salad ingredients into a one-thumb Survivors-like RPG
summary: A hero called Youtiao and another called Nanas sounds like a shopping list, and pretty much is one. Rojak is the Malaysian and Singaporean fruit-and-veg salad, and all six of the Kampong Rojak crew in Rojak Rush are named after what goes into it. It’s a one-thumb survivors RPG, out now on iOS. You drag to move, and your hero does the fighting on its own against swarms of Veilbound creatures. Every level-up deals three cards. You pick new powers, stack them and evolve them into something much bigger. Kinda what Vampire Survivors did. Then there are pets, a 186 of them, summoned with moon charms, and up to three fight beside you with a skill each. The odds for every pet are shown before you spend, and ten summons in a row always include an Epic or better. ... [MORE]

title: Death in the Water 2 gives you the 'privilege' of surviving deep-sea horror on iOS
summary: I have a fear of deep water. If you asked me to either run nude, covered in barbecue sauce, through a pack of hungry zombie-werewolves-vampires, or be dropped into the middle of the deep sea where I can't see the bottom for five minutes, I'm getting my running shoes on. All of which is to say that Death in the Water 2 is my perfect nightmare as it arrives on iOS. Death in the Water 2 sees you taking on the role of a deep-sea diving bounty hunter exploring Blackwater Bay. This mysterious patch of sea is infamous for divers, ships and even planes meeting mysterious ends. And it's your job to dive in and explore, to find out exactly what lurks beneath. Lucky you. ... [MORE]

title: Clash Royale: The Grand Arena blazes past Kickstarter goal in under an hour
summary: It seems that we'll soon be seeing Clash Royale join Clash of Clans on the tabletop, as The Grand Arena, the upcoming spinoff from publisher Maestro Media in collaboration with Supercell, has blazed past its Kickstarter goal. Now at $82,000, more than three times the original goal, it seems we'll soon be seeing The Grand Arena grace stores. If you're not familiar, Maestro Media previously worked with Supercell to bring Clash of Clans: The Epic Raid to dining-room tables the world over. It translated the hit RTS into a multiplayer board game that featured the same base-building and base-raiding action of the original. Seemingly, The Epic Raid was successful enough to warrant further collaborations between the two companies. ... [MORE]

title: Accelebot turns your iPhone into a tilt-controlled platformer you can play one-handed
summary: You don’t get a single button in Accelebot. No d-pad, no jump icon parked in the corner, nothing. You tilt your iPhone to move, tap anywhere on the screen to jump, and that’s the whole control scheme, playable one-handed in portrait. It’s a 2D platformer, and it’s out now on the App Store. It comes from solo developer Robert Perez. The levels are large, with secrets tucked away for anyone who goes poking around. The level select screen keeps track of which ones you’ve found. Each level also logs your total time, so you can chase your own best or the developer’s, and there’s a quick menu for switching off the sound effects and music without leaving a level. Wearable cosmetics are in there too. ... [MORE]

title: Pokémon TCG Pocket announces the debut of Dual-type cards in new Dual Fusion expansion
summary: Most trading card games thrive on predictability, where your knowledge of the game and your opponent's hand is a key strategic strength. For example, in Pokémon, you know certain types are strong against others, like Electric against Water. But Pokémon TCG Pocket is upsetting that paradigm of predictability with the debut of dual-type cards in their upcoming Dual Fusion expansion, which arrives on October 29th! Now, we all know that in Pokémon you have different 'types', be that Fighting, Fire or Metal. And it's the rock-paper-scissors at the centre of these different card types that forms the basis of the game. But dual-type cards boast two instead, and are guaranteed to switch things up in the new Dual Fusion expansion. ... [MORE]

title: Momolitos brings 600 creatures to iOS, with food deciding what they become
summary: Drawing 600 of anything sounds like a lot. Drawing 600 creatures, and then programming the thing they live in, is what Goca, the solo developer behind Goca Games, has done with Momolitos, and I’d like to think there’s a sketchbook somewhere that’s just eyes and tails. Momolitos launches on iOS this week, alongside Switch and Steam, and what you feed your creatures decides what they turn into. You start with an egg, raise whatever hatches, and head out into a handful of colourful worlds looking for ingredients. Bring them back, try a new food, see what happens. event_model_payload.summary: If you've been looking for a new tennis-based sports sim to play, then you're not exactly spoilt for choice. Football and baseball get plenty of attention, but tennis? Not so much. That is, unless you hop into Champion Tennis, the new game from Mnshine studio, now available to purchase on Google Play, with a free demo on the Chinese platform TapTap! Champion Tennis is a surprisingly quirky arcade tennis sim that has you making your way through individual cups while gathering absurd upgrades. You'll gather skill cards offering various upgrades and moves to help you out, even letting you hurl lightning, ice and meteor shots at your opponent. And with a huge number of cups, AI opponents and other content, it seems almost perfect. ... [MORE]

title: Hay Day sees Most Haunted Host Yvette Fielding appear as part of Halloween celebrations
summary: Hay Day is continuing its suite of recent celebrity collabs that have featured the likes of Gordon Ramsay and Joe Jonas, tying it into the spookiest month of the year. As part of their Halloween event, Hay Day has teamed up with Yvette Fielding, the host of the long-running UK ghost-hunting show Most Haunted. The collaboration sees Fielding lend her likeness, which has graced Most Haunted on and off since 2002, to a new advert featuring her investigating Cogges Manor Farm and inviting the spectral entity haunting it to play Hay Day. Naturally, that ties into the new, spooky update arriving in-game. ... [MORE]

title: Cult Vacui has you racing against time in a tense, terrifying point-and-click adventure
summary: It seems as though nothing good comes of heading to remote Scottish islands. And Cult Vacui is only further evidence of that, as the horror point-and-click adventure, with the constantly ticking clock, arrives on iOS and Android! So step in, get moving and watch the minutes fly by towards true terror. Cult Vacui sees you step back in time to the 19th century, as you arrive on the remote island of Barra in Scotland, to take up your role as new caretaker of the Gladstone summer estate. Fortunately, you arrive after the friendly local cult has already conducted their ritual, but unfortunately, it's not quite over yet, and you only have a mere few hours to prepare for the final act. ... [MORE]

This irreverent, wacky take on the adventure game genre offers plenty of twists and turns, plus plenty of humour. And it stars none other than the most famous detective in history and his loyal companion! Crushed in Time sees Sherlock & Watson out to once more solve mysteries in Victorian England. Or, at least, they would be if the game they were in wasn't missing a crucial NPC! Now, it's up to you to guide the dynamic duo through the game, trying to hold everything together and regularly shattering the fourth wall in the process. ... [MORE]
